gloss: to shatter; to smash; to dash (hopes)

definitions.gloss: to shatter; to smash to pieces
definitions.explanation: To break something hard into fragments with force. The prefix {打|う}ち〜 adds vigor to {砕|くだ}く, so the breaking is decisive and complete.

definitions.gloss: to dash; to crush (hopes, dreams, illusions)
definitions.explanation: To destroy something abstract that someone was holding on to, such as a dream, an expectation, or a belief. This figurative use is the more common one in writing.

examples.english: To smash the rock to pieces.

examples.english: The defeat in the final match completely shattered hopes of winning the championship.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く
- The passive {打|う}ち{砕|くだ}かれる is very common in the figurative sense, since the person is usually the one whose hopes were crushed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to shatter someone's dream
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to dash hopes
- ⟦{幻想|げんそう}→幻想：06753_gensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to shatter an illusion
- ⟦{岩|いわ}→岩：00850_iwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{砕|くだ}く: to smash a rock

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{砕|くだ}く→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧: to crush — the plain verb, without the force and finality of {打|う}ち〜
- ⟦{粉砕|ふんさい}→粉砕：13874_funsai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pulverize — Sino-Japanese and more technical, also used of crushing an opponent
